title: Authentication bypass by spoofing in AMD Secure Encrypted Virtualization (SEV) firmware could allow a malicious…
description: CVE-2026-40668 is a medium severity vulnerability in AMD Secure Encrypted Virtualization (SEV) firmware. It involves an authentication bypass via spoofing that could allow a malicious hypervisor to request attestation reports for VMPL 0. No affected versions or patches are specified. There are no known exploits in the wild.
